title: Activation energy
caption: The activation energy is the minimum energy colliding particles need to react: the height of the barrier from the reactants to the transition state. It is the same whether the reaction is exothermic or endothermic overall.
alt: A reaction profile with the activation energy arrow from the reactants up to the transition state.
description: The curve rises to the transition state; the arrow Ea spans this rise.
It falls to the products, lower here: exothermic.
